motivation: The only positive core result has a small held-out MSE gain (0.00102884) and lacks a null distribution. Quantify whether an equally large gain commonly arises when the year-specific effective-colony state is disconnected from next-year growth while all baseline variables and the LOYO procedure remain unchanged.
permutation_unit: start-year block of effective_colony_number values across islands
null_construction: Keep response next_growth, current_total, island identity, start_year and end_year fixed on every row.
Within each start-year availability stratum, randomly permute donor years.
For every target year and island, replace effective_colony_number only with the value from the same island in the donor year.
Use a single donor-year mapping for all islands in that year, preserving the cross-island covariance structure of the topology block.
Define strata only by the set of islands with an eligible transition so five-island pre-extinction years are never exchanged with four-island post-Litchfield years.
Re-run the exact frozen leave-one-end-year-out C0/C1 pipeline, including training-fold standardization, for every permutation.
strata_definition: derived mechanically from the tuple of island IDs present in each start year; no outcome-dependent strata
primary_p_value: (1 + number of permuted gains >= observed gain) / (B + 1), one-sided
reported_null_summaries: mean, SD, 2.5%, 50%, 95%, 97.5% and 99% quantiles of permuted MSE gain
observed-gain percentile in the null distribution
one-sided coefficient permutation p-value and coefficient null quantiles

interpretation_rules.manuscript_consequence: If p > 0.05, the colony-network result cannot remain a positive pillar of the JAE manuscript. If p <= 0.05, report the permutation uncertainty explicitly and proceed to a separate same-census mechanical-coupling diagnostic before strengthening novelty claims.

boundaries: This is a post-positive diagnostic, not an independent preregistered confirmation.
The null tests incremental year-specific alignment of N_eff, not causality or external habitat fragmentation.
No alternative topology metric, permutation stratum, seed or statistic may be selected after seeing the result.
Do not change the frozen C0/C1 models or LOYO folds.
